title: Add focused local and GitHub guardrails without running the product-wide suite
taskBrief: Build the repository guardrail identified by the current retro. Add a deterministic offline verifier that checks the pinned Node/npm contract, compact CURRENT_WORK/AGENTS navigation, ignored runtime/generated paths, both scoped Kimi agent profiles, and the collaboration manifest shape without reading secrets or calling a network/provider. Add an install script that sets core.hooksPath=.githooks, and a pre-commit hook that runs git diff --cached --check plus node --check only for staged .js/.mjs files. Add a GitHub Actions workflow that uses Node 24 and runs only this environment verifier; it must not run verify:all, paid calls, source refreshes, Expo builds, or historical gates. Add package scripts and a closure note. Do not change product behavior.
